map.系统内能变化等于吸热量减去对外做功。: The system internal-energy change equals heat absorbed minus work done by the system.

map.ΔU = Q − W（系统吸热为正、对外做功为正）。: DeltaU = Q - W (heat into system positive, work by system positive).
map.吸热 1000 J、做功 400 J → ΔU=600 J。: Heat 1000 J, work 400 J -> DeltaU=600 J.
map.📚 深度解析：热力学第一定律（闭口）: Deep dive: First law of thermodynamics (closed system)
map.闭口系统能量守恒 ΔU=Q−W。: Energy conservation of a closed system DeltaU=Q-W.
map.与稳流能量方程区分。: Distinguish from the steady-flow energy equation.
map.Q=1000 J, W=400 J：ΔU=Q−W=1000−400=600 J，: Q=1000 J, W=400 J: DeltaU=Q-W=1000-400=600 J, internal energy increases.
map.Q=0, W=−500（外界对系）：ΔU=500 J 升温。: Q=0, W=-500 (work on system): DeltaU=500 J, temperature rises.
map.约定系统对外做功为正，则 ΔU=Q−W；不同教材符号可能相反。: Conventionally work by the system is positive, so DeltaU=Q-W; some textbooks use the opposite sign.
map.闭口系（质量不变）；开口稳流用焓形式。: Closed system (constant mass); open steady flow uses the enthalpy form.
map.热力学第一定律：ΔU = Q − W（J，吸热 Q 与对外做功 W 均以正输入）: First law of thermodynamics: ΔU = Q − W (J, with heat absorbed Q and work done by the system W both entered as positive); linked cards: internal-energy change share of heat absorbed, work share of heat absorbed (%), internal-energy-change-to-work ratio (falling back to 1 when Q or W is 0). Validation: non-empty guards for Q and W (no denominator terms). Criteria: no fixed grading; ΔU > 0 means internal energy rises and < 0 means it falls.
